newsitem.title: UK: HSBC shoots higher as results top forecasts.
newsitem.headline: HSBC shoots higher as results top forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Anglo-Hong Kong banking group shot to a record high on Monday after first-half results beat analyst expectations.

From being down about 20p before the results were announced at 0800 GMT, the shares leapt higher to be up 122p, or 5.6 percent, at 23.15-1/2 stg by 0815 GMT, surpassing its previous high of 22.30 stg set on July 31.

Pre-tax profit rose 13 percent to 2.623 billion stg, compared with analyst expectations mostly in a range between 2.322 billion stg and 2.479 billion. The banking group said it would raise its dividend 33 percent to 20p per share.
"If you are looking for a single figure, the dividend is as strong an indicator as anything else about what this company feels about itself and its prospects," said one senior dealer.
By 0833 GMT the stock had slipped from its peak to be up 79p to 22.72-1/2 stg.
Analysts noted the volume of material released by the banking group but said at first glance the results looked strong. "The impression is preliminary but the results look very good," said one.
